notes: convegenius.com/careers.html links exactly one board, https://convegenius.keka.com/careers. That landing is a 1.6 KB JS shell whose only request is fetch('/ats/documents/0c764aaa-3be8-4767-b051-a188dd5c0cb6/careerportal/a540de213c6a48e2ba85623a91324040.html'); the fetched 12.6 KB careerportal document contains window.khConfig plus one embedjobs script that calls api/embedjobs/${portalName}/active/ (full active-job array), api/embedjobs/departments/ and api/organization/${portalName}/careerportalinfo, then renders cards grouped by departmentName and sorted by title. No filter or search form exists in either document, so there is no native filter request to replay: keyword and all facets must be applied locally to the active-jobs array.
